Barranquilla]]|Team}} }} '''Gian Louis Clavell López''' (born November 26, 1993) is a Puerto Rican professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Piratas de Quebradillas]] of the [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]] (BSN). He played three seasons of [[college basketball]] for the [[Colorado State Rams men's basketball|Colorado State Rams]], earning [[Mountain West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Mountain West Conference Player of the Year]] honors in 2017. He also represents the [[Puerto Rico national basketball team|Puerto Rican national team]]. ==College career== Clavell played [[college basketball]] for [[Northwest Kansas Technical College|Northwest Kansas]] between 2012 and 2014 and then [[Colorado State Rams men's basketball|Colorado State]] between 2014 and 2017.{{cite web|url=https://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Gian-Clavell/295534|title=Gian Clavell|work=eurobasket.com|access-date=August 4, 2024|url-access=subscription}} He was named [[Mountain West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Mountain West Conference Player of the Year]] in 2017, becoming the first CSU Ram to win the award.{{cite news|last1=Lyell|first1=Kelly|title=CSU's Gian Clavell named Mountain West Player of the Year|url=http://www.coloradoan.com/story/sports/csu/mens-basketball/2017/03/05/csus-gian-clavell-named-mountain-west-player-year/98773622/|access-date=May 20, 2017|work=[[Fort Collins Coloradoan]]|date=March 5, 2017}} ==Professional career== After graduating from college, Clavell had a three-game stint with [[Brujos de Guayama]] in Puerto Rico prior to the [[2017 NBA draft]]. After going undrafted, he joined the [[Miami Heat]] for the [[2017 NBA Summer League]]. On July 23, 2017, he signed a partially-guaranteed deal with the [[Dallas Mavericks]] to join the preseason roster.{{cite web|title=Mavericks sign guard Gian Clavell|url=https://www.mavs.com/mavericks-sign-guard-gian-clavell/|website=NBA.com|access-date=August 1, 2017|date=August 1, 2017}} His contract would later be converted to a [[two-way contract|two-way deal]], meaning throughout his time with the Mavericks, he would split playing time between Dallas and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Texas Legends]].{{cite web|title=Mavericks convert contract of Gian Clavell into two-way contract|url=https://www.mavs.com/mavericks-convert-contract-gian-clavell-two-way-contract/|website=NBA.com|access-date=October 16, 2017|date=October 16, 2017}} He played seven NBA games{{cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/c/clavegi01/gamelog/2018|title=Gian Clavell 2017-18 Game Log|work=basketball-reference.com|access-date=August 4, 2024}} before being waived by the Mavericks on November 17, 2017.{{cite web|title=Mavericks sign Antonius Cleveland to two-way contract; waive Clavell|url=https://www.mavs.com/mavericks-sign-antonius-cleveland-two-way-contract-waive-clavell/|website=NBA.com|access-date=November 17, 2017|date=November 17, 2017}}{{Dead link|date=December 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} In January 2018, Clavell joined [[Sakarya BB]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi|Turkish Super League]] (BSL). In July 2018, Clavell joined the [[Golden State Warriors]] for the [[2018 NBA Summer League]]. On August 3, 2018, he signed a one-year deal with [[CB Estudiantes|Movistar Estudiantes]] of the [[Liga ACB]].{{cite news |title=ACB.COM - Gian Clavell, puntos y juventud para el perímetro estudiantil |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=142443 |access-date=3 August 2018 |work=www.acb.com |date=3 August 2018 |language=es-ES}}{{cite news |title=Estudiantes signs Gian Clavell |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/spain/acb/284500/estudiantes-signs-gian-clavell.html |access-date=3 August 2018 |work=Sportando |date=3 August 2018}} In July 2019, Clavell joined the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] for [[2019 NBA Summer League]]. On December 11, 2019, he signed with [[Bursaspor Basketbol|Frutti Extra Bursaspor]] of the Turkish BSL.{{Cite web|url=http://basketball.com.tr/gian-clavell-frutti-extra-bursasporda/|title=Gian Clavell Frutti Extra Bursaspor'da|last=|first=|date=December 11, 2019|website=|publisher=Basketball.com.tr|language=Turkish|access-date=January 8, 2020}} In 12 games to finish the 2019–20 season, he averaged 18.7 points, 3.5 rebounds, 1.7 assists and 1.6 steals per game. On October 24, 2020, Clavell signed with [[BC Avtodor Saratov|Avtodor Saratov]] of the [[VTB United League]].{{cite news |title=Gian Clavell signs with BC Avtodor Saratov |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/gian-clavell-signs-with-bc-avtodor-saratov/ |website=Sportando |access-date=24 October 2020 |date=24 October 2020 |last1=Lupo |first1=Nicola }} In April 2021, he joined [[Promitheas Patras B.C.|Promitheas Patras]] of the [[Greek Basket League]]. He appeared in 11 games to finish the season. On August 11, 2021, Clavell signed with [[BC Budivelnyk|Budivelnyk Kyiv]] of the [[Ukrainian Basketball SuperLeague]].{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/budivelnyk-announce-drew-gordon-gian-clavell/|title=Budivelnyk announce Drew Gordon, Gian Clavell|last=|first=|date=August 11, 2021|website=|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=August 11, 2021 |last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }} In 2022, Clavell played for [[Cangrejeros de Santurce (basketball)|Cangrejeros de Santurce]] of the [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]]. In 35 games, he averaged 15.0 points, 2.9 rebounds and 2.5 assists per game. On June 24, 2022, Clavell signed with [[BC Prometey|Prometey]] of the [[Latvian-Estonian Basketball League]].{{Cite web|url=https://prometeybc.com/ua/novosti/dzhyan-klavell-hravets-bk-prometey-u-sezoni-202223|title=Джиан Клавелл - гравець БК "Прометей" у сезоні 2022/23|last=|first=|date=June 24, 2022|website=prometeybc.com|publisher=|language=uk|access-date=July 8, 2022}} After another stint with Cangrejeros de Santurce in 2023, he returned to Prometey for the 2023–24 season. In 2024, Clavell played for [[Piratas de Quebradillas]] of the BSN. ==National team career== Clavell represents [[Puerto Rico men's national basketball team|Puerto Rico]] at the international level. He was part of the team that helped Puerto Rico qualify for the [[Basketball at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2024 Summer Olympics]] after defeating both [[Italy men's national basketball team|Italy]] in the semifinals and [[Lithuania men's national basketball team|Lithuania]] in the final of one of four [[2024 FIBA Men's Olympic Qualifying Tournaments]].{{cite web |title=Puerto Rico ends 20-year Olympic drought with historic win over Lithuania|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-olympic-qualifying-tournament-2024-san-juan-puerto-rico/news/puerto-rico-ends-20-year-olympic-draught-with-historic-win-over-lithuania |website=fiba.basketball |date=7 July 2024}} ==Personal life== Clavell's brother, [[Gilberto Clavell|Gilberto]], is also a professional basketball player and played college basketball at [[Sam Houston State Bearkats men's basketball|Sam Houston State]].{{cite news|last1=Lyell|first1=Kelly|title=CSU's Clavell plans to follow brother's path to pros|url=http://www.coloradoan.com/story/sports/csu/mens-basketball/2015/01/09/csu-clavell-follows-brother-path-pros/21524977/|access-date=May 20, 2017|work=[[Fort Collins Coloradoan]]|date=January 9, 2015}} On March 1, 2025, Clavell's wife announced on Instagram that he had a brush with death due to complications from [[appendicitis]]. He had been admitted to the [[intensive care unit|ICU]] on February 26 but had a [[febrile seizure]] due to the severe infection.{{cite web |title=Granada's Gian Clavell almost dies due to appendicitis complications |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/acb/1791886/granadas-gian-clavell-almost-dies-after-appendicitis-complications/ |website=Eurohoops |access-date=11 March 2025 |language=en
